title: हवेली का 100 साल पुराना खौफनाक सच | रात के किस्से
topic: हवेली के तहखाने में छिपा 100 साल पुराना जानलेवा राज़ और गायब हुए पहरेदारों का खौफनाक सच
description:
क्या सुनसान हवेली के कड़े नियम आपको बचाने के लिए नहीं, बल्कि बलि चढ़ाने के लिए बनाए गए थे? जानिए रघु के साथ घटी इस रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाली खौफनाक रात की पूरी दास्तान।

रात के 3 बजते ही हवेली के बंद कमरे का ताला अपने आप टूट गया। रघु को मिली पुरानी डायरी और गुप्त तहखाने के नक्शे में सात गायब पहरेदारों के बाद आठवाँ नाम रघु का खुद का लिखा था! क्या रघु इस जानलेवा चक्रव्यूह से बच पाएगा या ठाकुर का काला सच उसका भी अंत कर देगा?

ऐसे ही रोंगटे खड़े कर देने वाले रहस्यों और खौफनाक हॉरर कहानियों के लिए हमारे चैनल 'रात के किस्से' को अभी लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें!

#HorrorStories #HindiHorrorStories #हवेलीकासच #RaatKeKisse #HindiKahaniya
thumb_visual: A terrified young Indian night guard in uniform holding a flickering lantern, wide-eyed with extreme shock inside a dark, ancient creepy Indian mansion. In front of him, a massive iron door magically breaks open with glowing mysterious light and dark mist emanating from inside. Dramatic high contrast lighting, deep shadows, saturated dark blue and fiery orange tones, intense rim lighting on the guard's face, 2D horror story illustration style, dynamic composition with clean empty space on the left side for text, highly detailed.
so_far: रघु ने गाँव की सुनसान हवेली में नाइट गार्ड की नौकरी ली थी। ठाकुर ने उसे रात की पहरेदारी के तीन सख्त नियम बताए थे। आधी रात को 2:45 बजे रघु को पूर्वी कमरे से किसी के चीखने की आवाजें आईं। नियम तोड़कर जब उसने झांका, तो उसे गायब हो चुके पुराने पहरेदार की खून से सनी डायरी मिली।

shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard in navy uniform staring in complete horror while backing into wooden door frame.
Medium wide shot of guard clutching his brass lantern tightly against his chest realization visible on face.
Wide shot of guard trembling near open doorway as old man stands ominously in center of shadowy room.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रघु ने पीछे हटते हुए चिल्लाया... 'मैं तुम्हारी बलि का शिकार नहीं बनूँगा!'
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform pushing past the old man into the long arched hallway.
shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard pushing forcefully past old man into long arched hallway to escape.
Medium wide shot of guard sprinting frantically down dark corridor away from standing figure of old man.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उसने लालटेन ज़मीन पर पटकी और आग हवेली के भारी पर्दों में फैल गई!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of glass shattering as bright orange flames quickly engulf massive velvet drapes along the stone wall.
shots: Wide shot of glass lantern shattering on stone floor bright orange oil flames spreading instantly across ground.
Wide shot of bright orange fire climbing up heavy velvet drapes hanging against ancient cracked brick wall.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: धुएँ और आग के बीच रघु नीचे तहखाने की सीढ़ियों की तरफ भागा!
scenes.style: out of breath, desperate running tone
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform running down narrow spiral stone stairs into darkness.
shots: Wide shot of thick grey smoke filling hallway while bright flames illuminate guard running toward dark stairs down.
Wide shot of 45-year-old guard running down narrow spiral stone staircase into pitch-black cellar depth.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लेकिन तहखाने में उतरते ही उसका पैर किसी ठंडी चीज से टकराया।
scenes.visual: Wide shot of dark damp cellar floor where rusty chains and ancient iron cages line the stone foundation.
shots: Wide shot of dark damp cellar floor where rusty iron chains and ancient cages line stone walls under water droplets.
Medium wide shot of guard stumbling on wet stone floor boot striking metallic object buried in shadow.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उसने नीचे देखा... पूरे तहखाने में पिछले सात पहरेदारों के जूते बिखरे पड़े थे!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a damp cellar floor littered with ancient worn leather boots, rusted security badges, and worn caps.
shots: Wide shot of damp cellar floor scattered with worn leather security boots rusted badges and old caps.
Medium wide shot of guard pointing flashlight down at cluster of seven distinct pairs of old security boots on wet stone.
Wide shot of guard standing amidst scattered items of previous guards in misty underground stone chamber.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और उन जूतों के बीच एक पुराना पीतल का डिब्बा रखा था।
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a heavy rectangular brass chest sitting atop a stone altar in the middle of the flooded cellar.
shots: Wide shot of rectangular ornate brass chest sitting atop carved stone altar in center of flooded cellar floor.
Medium wide shot of brass chest gleaming faintly under flashlight beam amidst scattered boots and wet rocks.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या आप जानते हैं उस डिब्बे के अंदर क्या था?
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform approaching the brass chest slowly with a flash lamp.
shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard approaching brass chest slowly on flooded stone floor holding flashlight beam steady.
Medium wide shot of guard kneeling beside brass box on stone pedestal reaching hands out to open lock latch.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: डिब्बे के ऊपर एक तांत्रिक यंत्र खुदा हुआ था... और उसके अंदर आठ तांबे की चाबियाँ थीं!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of an open brass container revealing intricate ancient keys resting on velvet cloth inside.
shots: Wide shot of opened brass container revealing intricate geometric occult engravings on lid inner surface.
Medium wide shot showing eight antique copper keys resting neatly on dark velvet cloth inside opened brass box.
Wide shot of guard staring down into opened brass chest illuminated by white torch light beam in dark cellar.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आठवीं चाबी हवेली के गुप्त पिछले चोर-दरवाज़े की थी!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform picking up a ornate copper key with etched symbols.
shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard picking up large ornate copper key etched with ancient symbols from brass container.
Medium wide shot showing guard holding shining copper key close to torchlight inspecting carved numbers on handle.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रघु के चेहरे पर उम्मीद की किरण आई... लेकिन तभी तहखाने का दरवाज़ा धड़ाम से बंद हो गया!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a massive stone slab sliding shut over the top of the stairwell with a loud thud.
shots: Wide shot of guard clutching copper key with hopeful look in wet cellar under torchlight beam.
Wide shot of massive stone slab sliding violently shut across top of stairwell entry with loud crash.
Medium wide shot of guard spinning around in panic as stairwell opening seals completely with stone slab.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: पूरे तहखाने में घना अँधेरा छा गया।
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the dimly lit basement plunge into pitch darkness, only the faint red embers from above visible through a grate.
shots: Wide shot of subterranean basement plunged into deep shadow only faint dim red ember glow visible through high ceiling iron grate.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और अँधेरे में... किसी के पानी पर चलने की छप-छप आवाज़ रघु के ठीक पीछे से आई!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of shallow water on the cellar floor rippling outwards as unseen heavy footsteps approach.
shots: Wide shot of shallow water on cellar floor rippling outward from heavy unseen footsteps approaching from darkness.
Medium wide shot of guard freezing in place on wet floor turning his head slowly toward dark corner.
Wide shot of small water ripples spreading across stone ground near guard boots in shadowy cellar.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रघु ने थरथराते हाथों से अपनी टॉर्च जलाकर पीछे घुमाया...
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a beam of light cutting through misty cellar darkness, revealing damp stone arches.
shots: Wide shot of guard turning on metal flashlight with shaking hands casting bright beam into dark damp mist.
Medium wide shot of white light beam cutting through foggy basement darkness toward wet arched wall.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: टॉर्च की रोशनी सामने दीवार पर पड़ी... और रघु की चीख निकल गई!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the cellar wall revealing a monstrous towering shadow with long thin claws stretching across the stones.
shots: Wide shot of torch light beam hitting cellar stone wall revealing giant towering black shadow with thin long claws.
Medium wide shot of guard stepping back rapidly into stone pillar mouth open screaming in pure terror.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: सामने ठाकुर नहीं खड़ा था... सामने हवेली का 100 साल पुराना वो भयानक साया खड़ा था!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a dark tall spectral entity with glowing hollow eyes rising from the damp corners of the basement floor.
shots: Wide shot of tall dark spectral shadow entity with faint glowing eyes rising from damp corner of basement.
Medium wide shot of monstrous shadowy figure stretching high toward vaulted stone ceiling in cellar.
Wide shot of guard pointing flashlight at towering shadowy mist shape standing between wet archways.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उस साए की लंबी पतली उँगलियाँ सीधे रघु की गर्दन की तरफ बढ़ने लगीं!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of dark smoky arms reaching out towards a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform who backs into the wall.
shots: Wide shot of smoky dark arms extending long thin shadowy fingers forward toward guard backed against stone wall.
Medium wide shot of guard ducking low near damp ground as black shadowy claws reach across torch light beam.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रघु ने तुरंत जेब से वो तांबे की चाबी निकाली और सामने बनी छोटी खिड़की का ताला खोलने की कोशिश की!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform frantically inserting the antique key into a small iron grate lock.
shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard pulling antique copper key from uniform pocket near small iron escape grate wall.
Medium wide shot of guard frantically inserting key into rusted padlock mounted on small earthen tunnel window grate.
Wide shot of guard twisting copper key inside lock while dark mist entity looms closely behind him.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चाबी ताले में घूम गई... कटिक!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of small iron grated door snapping open into a narrow earthen escape tunnel.
shots: Wide shot of small rusty iron grated door snapping open into narrow dark earthen escape crawlway tunnel.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लेकिन जैसे ही रघु ने सुरंग में कदम रखा... किसी ने उसका दाहिना पैर कसकर पकड़ लिया!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a dark shadow claw gripping the ankle of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform at the tunnel entrance.
shots: Wide shot of guard sliding legs forward into narrow dirt tunnel while leaning on elbows outside opening.
Medium wide shot of dark skeletal claw tightly gripping ankle of guard black security boot at tunnel entrance.
Wide shot of guard looking back in desperation as he gets pulled backward out of dark tunnel opening.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: वो साया नहीं... ठाकुर का आधा जला हुआ हाथ था!
scenes.visual: Wide shot showing a 60-year-old man in white kurta pajama with singed clothes crawling on the cellar ground holding Raghu's leg.
shots: Wide shot showing 60-year-old man with burnt clothes crawling on wet cellar ground clutching guard leg firmly.
Medium wide shot of old man singed hand holding tightly onto security guard boot lace on damp stone.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: ठाकुर ने कराहते हुए कहा... 'तुम बाहर नहीं जा सकते रघु... बलि पूरी होनी ही होगी!'
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 60-year-old man pulling the guard backward away from the small iron portal.
shots: Wide shot of old man pulling guard backward away from small iron portal along wet cellar floor.
Medium wide shot of old man looking up from ground with grim burnt face while holding guard leg.
Wide shot of guard struggling against old man grip near dirt tunnel opening under flickering dim light.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रघु ने अपनी दूसरी लात पूरी ताकत से ठाकुर के चेहरे पर मारी!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform kicking free and crawling fast into the narrow tunnel.
shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard kicking hard with left boot to break free from old man grip.
Medium wide shot of guard quickly crawling headfirst into narrow dirt escape tunnel after breaking free.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: ठाकुर पीछे गिरा और वो खौफनाक काला साया ठाकुर के ऊपर झपट पड़ा!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the tall spectral shadow completely enveloping the fallen figure of the 60-year-old man on the cellar floor.
shots: Wide shot of old man falling backward onto wet stone as tall spectral shadow entity swoops down over him.
Medium wide shot of dark smoky shadows enveloping old man on cellar floor while guard crawls inside tunnel.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: हवेली के अंदर से ठाकुर की भयानक चीख गूँज उठी!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the mansion exterior at night, fire light pulsing through lower windows as smoke rises.
shots: Wide shot of exterior mansion at night bright orange fire glowing through lower windows as dark smoke rises into sky.
Wide shot of mansion roof against moonlit night sky as flames pour from high arched windows.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रघु सुरंग के रास्ते घिसटता हुआ हवेली के बाहर बने पुराने कुएँ के पास निकला!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform climbing out of a stone tunnel exit near a ruined village well.
shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard crawling out from hidden stone tunnel opening near ruined village well outside mansion.
Medium wide shot of guard standing up on grassy earth near old stone well under open moonlit night sky.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: बाहर ताज़ी हवा थी... रात का 3:30 बज रहा था। हवेली धू-धू कर जल रही थी।
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the burning ancient mansion in the distance against a dark starry sky with heavy smoke clouds.
shots: Wide shot of burning ancient mansion blazing bright in distance under dark starry midnight sky.
Medium wide shot of guard taking deep breath of fresh night air looking back at fiery estate structure.
Wide shot of glowing flames illuminating night fog around ruined well as guard stands outside safely.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: रघु ने राहत की साँस ली। उसे लगा कि 100 साल पुराना वो भयानक शाप हमेशा के लिए खत्म हो गया...
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform leaning against the stone well wall, panting.
shots: Wide shot of 45-year-old guard leaning exhaustedly against stone well wall panting with closed eyes.
Medium wide shot of guard sitting on grass near old well edge wiping sweat from forehead under moonlight.
Wide shot of calm moonlit night surrounding guard as fire burns quietly at distant mansion background.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: लेकिन तभी... रघु की नज़र अपनी जेब पर पड़ी!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man in navy blue security uniform reaching into his uniform pocket and pulling out an object.
shots: Wide shot of guard reaching hand slowly into his navy blue uniform jacket pocket with surprised look.
Medium wide shot of guard pulling small heavy metallic object out from his pocket under pale moonlight.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: उसके जेब में तांबे का वही शापित तावीज़ रखा था... जो ठाकुर के गले में था!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of a 45-year-old man holding the antique copper rune amulet in his hand under pale moonlight.
shots: Wide shot of guard holding antique copper rune amulet open in his palm under soft white moon glow.
Medium wide shot showing copper pendant engraved with occult symbols gleaming brightly in guard hand.
Wide shot of guard staring down at copper talisman in disbelief while leaning against stone well rim.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: और कुएँ के अंदर से ठाकुर की वही आवाज़ फुसफुसाई... 'मालिक बदल गया है रघु!'
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the deep dark stone well as black smoke begins to rise slowly from inside it.
shots: Wide shot of dark deep mouth of stone well as black smoke begins rising slowly from inside.
Medium wide shot of guard looking down into dark opening of stone well in sudden shock and fear.
Wide shot of black mist pouring out from well rim into moonlit air around standing guard.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: क्या रघु खुद उस शापित हवेली का नया रखवाला बन चुका है? जानिए अगले और आखिरी भाग में!
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the burning mansion and the misty well under the full moon.
shots: Wide shot of guard standing beside misty well with copper amulet silhouette framed against distant burning haveli.
Medium wide shot of guard looking holding copper talisman tight under moonlit night.
Wide cinematic view of burning mansion estate and foggy stone well under full bright moon in night sky.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: इस खौफनाक कहानी का भाग 3 देखने के लिए चैनल को तुरंत सब्सक्राइब करें और बैल आइकन दबाएं!
scenes.style: enthusiastic channel outro, warm and confident
scenes.visual: Wide atmospheric graphic shot of 'रात के किस्से' title splash screen over misty haveli background.
shots: Wide atmospheric graphic shot of mysterious ancient haveli surrounded by dense fog under silver moon.
Wide cinematic shot of shadowy mansion gates under moonlight with eerie blue lighting effect.
Wide closing cinematic view of burning estate lights flickering against foggy dark forest horizon.
